in conveyor belts, trusted by industries worldwide to deliver the longest-lasting solutions. Our
belts are more than products; they are a commitment to quality, backed by a legacy of innovation and
leadership. By prioritizing sustainable practices and material traceability, we help customers not
only extend belt lifespans but also reduce operational costs and environmental impact.

For more than 150 years, our market leadership has been built on the foundations of the very highest
standards of craftmanship to create the most reliable and durable products available.

to reduce downtime and cost through increased productivity.

We passionately believe that greater sustainability is best achieved by maximising the operational
lifetime, thereby dramatically reducing waste in all its forms.

### [safety-icon] Safety

We believe that human and environmental safety is an integral part of every stage, from responsible
sourcing of raw materials to product end of life.

### [our-people-icon] Diversity

feel valued and respected.

### [innovation-icon] Continued Innovation for a Brighter Future

We are the leaders in conveyor belt innovation, from optimum fire safety to the toughest, most
damage-resistant belts available anywhere in the world.

## Conveying Quality for Over 150 Years

For over 150 years, we have set the global standard for durability, reliability, and craftsmanship
in conveyor belts, trusted by industries worldwide to deliver the longest-lasting solutions. Our
belts are more than products; they are a commitment to quality, backed by a legacy of innovation and
leadership. By prioritizing sustainable practices and material traceability, we help customers not
only extend belt lifespans but also reduce operational costs and environmental impact.

### [craftsmanship-icon] Craftsmanship and Quality

For more than 150 years, our market leadership has been built on the foundations of the very highest
standards of craftmanship to create the most reliable and durable products available.

### [productivity-icon] Productivity

Supplying the most reliable, hardest-wearing and longest-lasting conveyor belts helps our customers
to reduce downtime and cost through increased productivity.

### [sustainable-manufacturing-icon] Sustainable Manufacturing and Material Traceability

We passionately believe that greater sustainability is best achieved by maximising the operational
lifetime, thereby dramatically reducing waste in all its forms.

### [safety-icon] Safety

We believe that human and environmental safety is an integral part of every stage, from responsible
sourcing of raw materials to product end of life.

### [our-people-icon] Diversity

We foster a workplace that values diversity and inclusion, creating a culture where all employees
feel valued and respected.

### [innovation-icon] Continued Innovation for a Brighter Future

We are the leaders in conveyor belt innovation, from optimum fire safety to the toughest, most
damage-resistant belts available anywhere in the world.

## The longest lasting conveyor belting in the world made in Americas, EMEAI, and Australia

For conveyor belts that deliver the lowest cost per ton of material conveyed, you need more than
just durability—you need a seamless synergy between the best class cover compound and the carcass,
tailored to your specific needs. You need Fenner Dunlop.

fabricator of industrial rubber products with 6 locations in the State of Florida. They offer all
types of industrial hose, both rubber and thermoplastic including air & water, chemical transfer,
food handling, marine application, petroleum, dock hoses along with specialty hoses such as steam
and sandblasting. The company provides fabrication, testing and certification of hose assemblies to
NAHAD, RMA and U.S. Coast Guard specifications. Goodyear also offers hydraulic hose and couplings,
adapters and hose building equipment from Parker Hannifin Corporation. The company represents
Continental ContiTech, Dixon Valve & Coupling, Flexaust, Hose Master, Kuriyama, Kanaflex, Novaflex,
Pacific Echo along with many other leading hose and fitting manufacturers. Additionally, the company
offers a high quality private brand of hose and belting products under their registered trademark,
GOOD FLEX®. These products are visible at [https://goodflex.us][135]

Goodyear Rubber offers Power Transmission Products from Continental ContiTech including v-belts,
timing belts, synchronous belts along with sheaves and related hardware. Conveyor Belting, both
lightweight and heavy duty rubber and thermoplastic styles with cleats, sidewalls, guides, buckets

# **Screw Conveyor & Stainless Steel Auger Conveyor ****Manufacturers**

 

**Get it and keep it moving with Screw Conveyors, Augers, and Bulk Material Handling Systems from
Austin Mac, Inc.**

Bulk material handling challenges are not a problem with [augers, screw conveyors and bulk material
handling systems][16] from Austin Mac. No matter your industry or material, we can design, build and
deliver the right screw conveyor system for you.

We custom design your bulk material handling system using state-of-the-art CAD drawings, CAD plasma
and laser burning, CNC forming and automated welding.

## Screw Conveyors, Augers, and Bulk Material Handling Systems to handle your toughest jobs:

 

A versatile and hard-working screw conveyor system from the Washington metal fabricators Austin Mac
is one you know stands ready to handle the demands of your materials. Abrasive, wet or dry,
corrosive, sticky or viscous, light or heavy, hot or cold — you name it and Austin Mac will deliver
a screw conveyor system to handle the job.

[Washington metal fabricators][17], Austin Mac, deliver quality screw conveyors, augers, and bulk
material handling systems at competitive prices. Additionally, we stock and deliver individual parts
and components for your existing screw conveyor or bulk material handling system in Washington and
across the USA.

Trust Austin Mac to meet your metal fabrication needs and elevate your operations to new heights.

## Conveyor Dynamics, Inc. (CDI)

##### Born in 1981, CDI pioneered the use of dynamic analysis to design modern, long (> 2km), high
##### capacity (> 10000 tph) overland and underground conveyor belts.

Not only do we design the longest and strongest belts in the world, our engineers create and sell
the leading conveyor belt design software tools, the most reliable control systems, and develop
improved belt, brake, and idler designs for manufacturers. We partner with the leading EPC and OEM's
around the world to supply the most cost effective and reliable conveyors in every major market.

In additional to designing new machines, our engineers conduct forensic engineering studies to
diagnose and fix failed conveyor belts. Our engineers understand the physics of conveyor belts, from
the complete system, to the individual proportional brake valve better than anyone else in the
world. If your conveyor is unreliable, CDI is here to change that.

## Our Achievements

### 🌍 Three World Records

We are proud to hold three world records in the conveyor industry, showcasing our commitment to
innovation and excellence.

### 📈 Over 80 Projects

With more than 80 successful projects completed, we have a proven track record of delivering
reliable conveyor solutions.

### 🕒 43+ Years in Business

For over 43 years, Conveyor Dynamics, Inc. has been a leader in the conveyor industry, providing
expert engineering services.

## Our Expertise

At CDI, we focus on the customer requirements to develop optimized overland systems where we use
next-generation tools such as BeltStat, BeltFlex, PStress, DEM, and ANSYS FEA.

### Overland Belt Engineering
* Long length belts, curves, and bi-directional transport
* Standard, tubular, cable, and air suspended belts
* Structural optimization of belt path
* Pulley and Roller Analysis
* Tensioning system design
* Component specifications
* Advanced technology for conveyor belts

### Control and Start-Up
* Philosophy and advanced control logic
* PLC programming
* Specialized control of motors and brakes
* Control start and stop of head, tail and intermediate motor stations
* Tachometers, UPSs, and data acquisition systems (DAQs)

### Forensic Engineering and Root Cause of Failure Analysis
* Brake systems audit
* Optimization of torque transmission and load distribution of motors
* Evaluation and optimization of control algorithms
* Pulley and Splice Evaluation Using FEA Analysis
* Recording and Evaluation of the actual dynamic behavior of the belt
* Actual system torque measurement

### Optimization and Design of Chutes
* Chute geometry optimization with DEM software
* Granular flow simulations in chutes, feeders, trays, crushers and mills
* Capacity studies and bottlenecks
* Identification and resolution of root cause of blockages, spills, material degradation, dust,
  misalignment and wear of liners
* Material calibration

## Our Expertise

At CDI, we focus on the customer requirements to develop optimized overland systems where we use
next-generation tools such as BeltStat, BeltFlex, PStress, DEM, and ANSYS FEA.

### Overland Belt Engineering
* Long length belts, curves, and bi-directional transport
* Standard, tubular, cable, and air suspended belts
* Structural optimization of belt path
* Pulley and Roller Analysis
* Tensioning system design
* Component specifications
* Advanced technology for conveyor belts

### Control and Start-Up
* Philosophy and advanced control logic
* PLC programming
* Specialized control of motors and brakes
* Control start and stop of head, tail and intermediate motor stations
* Tachometers, UPSs, and data acquisition systems (DAQs)

### Forensic Engineering and Root Cause of Failure Analysis
* Brake systems audit
* Optimization of torque transmission and load distribution of motors
* Evaluation and optimization of control algorithms
* Pulley and Splice Evaluation Using FEA Analysis
* Recording and Evaluation of the actual dynamic behavior of the belt
* Actual system torque measurement

### Optimization and Design of Chutes
* Chute geometry optimization with DEM software
* Granular flow simulations in chutes, feeders, trays, crushers and mills
* Capacity studies and bottlenecks
* Identification and resolution of root cause of blockages, spills, material degradation, dust,
  misalignment and wear of liners
* Material calibration

## DNC Automation Company

Industry 4.0, as the next industrial revolution, brings in a new wave of connected manufacturers and
smart factories. The disruptive technological advancements, such as machine learning, blockchain,
data intelligence, big data, Internet of Things (IoT), and analytics, are changing the way products
and services are manufactured, designed, and marketed.
The global race for innovation leadership in Industry 4.0 is picking up pace. Two-thirds of top
automation companies worldwide say that digitizing the production value chain is one of their
highest priorities.

we are prepared to help manufacturers to transform their factories into **SMART factories** or

manufacturing processes that leads to faster and more flexible operation process.

DNC offers comprehensive solutions from pre-sales design and manufacturing to project
implementation. We are experienced experts in providing professional consulting to serve our valued
customers. We help our customers train their engineers and make them more capable of improving their
production facilities.

lines of conveyor belts for almost every material handling application.

Our modernized standard workshops and advanced in-house testing apparatus along with competent team

World Class Machinery

Elcon Elastomers Pvt. Ltd. has best in class machinery. That combined with two decades of experience

ABOUT US

Established in 1987, we have become a reputed manufacturer in India for the production of industrial
rubber products. We supply to various industries such as automobile, engineering, & consumer
products industries.
We began manufacturing Conveyor & Transmission Belts in 2004. There has been an ever increasing
demand for our products due to their high quality; and coupled with industrialization, we continue
to augment our capacity periodically in order to meet the continually changing requirements of our
valued customers.
Our plant is managed by highly qualified and trained personnel. We own a fully equipped R & D
laboratory utilizing the latest testing equipment and techniques, which enables our company to
deliver the highest quality products. We control all stages of the production process; beginning
with the selection of raw materials, the in-processing procedures, and the final production stages
for transmission belts and conveyor belts.
Our products achieve a great reputation by combining the latest technology and techniques along with
constant interaction and input from our clients. All Elcon Elastomers Belt products comply with
IS/ISO/DIN/CSA/BS standards as well as unique customer specifications.
Thanks to our top of the line equipment, our state of the art manufacturing facilities, excellent
management team and customer service staff, Elcon Elastomers Pvt. Ltd. has expanded its valued
client base beyond India to multiple overseas companies with their individual requirements.

## Company Overview

**FORECH** is a global solutions provider in conveyor belts, rubber sheets, and material handling
accessories, committed to delivering export-quality products that ensure durability, efficiency, and
performance.

[ More about Forech ][25]

## Forech by the Numbers

Forech stands at the forefront of conveyor technology, manufacturing fabric and steel cord
reinforced rubber conveyor belts and providing an integrated range of products to enhance the
efficiency, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of conveyor systems.


## Our Journey

Built on decades of industry expertise, Forech is driven by a leadership team with over 40 years of
experience in delivering reliable and high-performance conveyor solutions.

### 1994

Re-organised as Forech India Ltd

### 2003

Commissioning of Dhaturi works

### 2005

ISO 9001:2000 accreditation from DNV

### 2006

Commissioning of Sidewall Belt assembly line

### 2009

ISO 14001 (2004), BS OHSAS 18001 (2007) & SA 8000 (2001) accreditation from BSI

### 2010

Steel Cord Belt Productions starts at Cheyyar(Chennai)

[ Milestones ][26]

## Research & Development

Our Research & Development (R&D) division plays a crucial role in strengthening our capabilities in
designing and manufacturing advanced pipe conveyor belt solutions.

## Empowering Industries Across the Globe

Forech is one of the largest manufacturers of conveyor belts for bulk material handling in India. We
have clients, installations and distributors across the world.

## Our Material Handling Solutions

We are a nationwide material handling systems integrator who provides turnkey engineered solutions
for our customers in the distribution, manufacturing, and warehousing environments.  Whether it is
looking to utilize the storage space in your facility with a racking system, increase your square
footage with a second level mezzanine, create more office space, or increase throughput and control
through automation/software, we have the solution for you.  Our qualified application engineers are
on standby to help you with your next project.

**What Is Material Handling?**

Material handling is a broad field that encompasses the storage, shipment, protection and control of
items in an industrial setting. This ranges from moving the individual components that make up an
item through a manufacturing facility to shipping out the finished product to its end user. Every
step of the way, the efficiency with which you handle materials affects your productivity,
profitability and overall performance.

**Logic Material Handling, Inc. is a leading provider of material handling solutions for customers
across the country. We have four main specialties:**
* [Storage Systems][82]
* [Industrial Structures][83]
* [Automation Systems][84]
* [Order Fulfillment Software][85]

 

We understand how each of these contribute to the effectiveness of your operation. Our custom
material handling systems are developed from this big-picture perspective, ensuring all components
work together to drive your productivity.

Count on our team for creative solutions to the specific problems facing your business, whether they
involve helping you make the best use of space in your facility, reducing errors, streamlining your
order-picking processes, improving safety when working with heavy or bulky products, or anything
else broadly related to material handling system design. Keep reading to learn more about the
products and material handling services we offer.

## This year marks Moog’s 75th anniversary, reflecting decades of resilience and ingenuity.

Founded in 1951 by Bill Moog with a bold vision to empower people and solve tough problems through
trust and innovation, our company grew from a small airplane hangar in East Aurora into a global
leader in aerospace, defense, industrial automation, and medical technology. Through change and
challenge, Moog has remained committed to innovation and culture. Today, we continue to shape the
way our world moves while building a sustainable business for generations to come.

## EXPERIENCE US

## RESILIENT AND ADEPT

We are an established leader in Conveyor belts & Rubber moulded products with 73 years experience
and more.
Our Plants located in India and South Africa have made Oriental Rubber Industries reach a global
sized capacity with exports to more than 40 countries making us strong in several geographies
including North America, Europe, Australia, Southern Africa, and the Middle East.
Oriental Rubber Industries was established on 20th Jan 1949 by our founder Mr. Sadanand Makar during
the formative days of Independent India. Since its inception in 1949, Oriental Rubber Industries has
come a long way to become a globally recognised rubber conveyor belt manufacturing company. With
manufacturing operations in India and South Africa, the company is now poised to become one of the
leading manufacturers and suppliers of conveyor belts and accessories catering to exacting
requirements of customers in more than 50 countries across the globe.

and more.

sized capacity with exports to more than 40 countries making us strong in several geographies
including North America, Europe, Australia, Southern Africa, and the Middle East.

manufacturing operations in India and South Africa, the company is now poised to become one of the
leading manufacturers and suppliers of conveyor belts and accessories catering to exacting
requirements of customers in more than 50 countries across the globe.

Welcome To Shetty Enterprises

# Top Industrial Conveyor Belt Manufacturer and Exporter in India

Shetty Enterprise, incorporated in 1999, is the country’s leading manufacturer, supplier and
exporter of a wide assortment of **conveyor belts,** which have wide-ranging applications in
numerous industries. We are a renowned name in this industry, supported by a huge experience in
manufacturing different types of conveyor belts, high-tech infrastructure, a highly skilled team of
professionals, and the fastest delivery, which keeps us a step ahead of our competitors. 

Our offered conveyor belts are manufactured using the finest-quality raw materials sourced from the
most reliable vendors in the domestic and international markets. Moreover, we can avail the best
quality **conveyor belts,** which have exceptional properties like high tensile strength,
dimensional stability, wear and tear resistance, and high durability; these products are available
at industry-leading prices.

Our Vision

To become the most preferred brand in conveyor belting solutions by 2025 and to accomplish an
enlargement of at least 100% every year.

Our Mission

Our main motive is 100% customer satisfaction by providing the highest quality products fabricated
from the best quality raw material and employing an inventive approach, fastest delivery and the
most satisfying after-sales service.

The conveyor belts manufactured by us are available in different technical specifications so that
they meet diverse customer requirements. Being in this industry for more than 20 years, we have
emerged as the [**best supplier and exporter of conveyor belts**][94] and have spread our
distribution network worldwide. In addition to that, our offered belts come with various features
such as high durability, eco-friendliness, less energy consumption, and low maintenance. We
manufacture and offer different types of conveyor belts which are constant moving strips and are
employed in various industries for carrying diverse materials from one place to another.

These **conveyor belts** have numerous applications conveying raw materials in cement plants, rail
unloading, coal handling for power plants, shoe industries, foundries, power generating industries,
used in mining and mineral industries, forest products, chemical industries, fertilizer and
granulation industries etc.

# TELS GLOBAL - International Logistics Solutions

TELS GLOBAL is an international logistics provider offering comprehensive services in transportation
and logistics industry by all modes of transport, including warehousing, insurance, financial and
other related services.

TELS GLOBAL works across Europe and Asia, as well as on the main routes to/from America offering its
customers quality, reliable and timely delivery of goods from anywhere in the world.

Flexibility of logistics solutions along with the development of various cargo delivery schemes
ensures effective risk management and sustainability of supply chains in any circumstances.

Long-term partnership with customers and contractors is the highest value for TELS GLOBAL, which
allows to reach the highest level of efficiency in business development for all the participants.

The drive for innovation development and comprehensive digital workspace makes TELS GLOBAL a
convenient and transparent logistics partner with unlimited opportunities for increasing the
efficiency of cooperation.
